title: Function Room Rental and Food & Beverage Minimums: Meetings & Events Tariff
content:
Function room rental under a Meetings & Events package is priced for the package hours, and each package carries a food and beverage minimum stated before service charge and sales tax. The tariff below gives, per package, the rental, the minimum, whether the rental is waived when food and beverage revenue reaches the minimum, and the contracted room nights of a linked group room block at which the rental is waived.

| Package | Function room rental for the package hours (USD) | Food and beverage minimum (USD) | Rental waived when food and beverage revenue reaches the minimum | Linked group room block room nights at which rental is waived |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Executive Boardroom Package | 0.00 | 0.00 | Yes | 0 (no such waiver) |
| Half-Day Meeting Package | 350.00 | 1500.00 | Yes | 20 |
| Full-Day Meeting Package | 600.00 | 2500.00 | Yes | 20 |
| Social Reception Package | 750.00 | 5000.00 | Yes | 20 |
| Wedding Celebration Package | 2500.00 | 12000.00 | Yes | 25 |
| Conference Plenary Package | 4500.00 | 25000.00 | Yes | 100 |

## Notes to the tariff

1. A figure of 0 in the linked group room block column means the package has no linked-block rental waiver; the Executive Boardroom Package is the only package in that position, and it also carries no rental and no minimum.
2. The rental-waiver-on-minimum entry reads Yes for every Meetings & Events package.
3. The minimum is measured on food and beverage revenue before service charge and sales tax.

## Hypothetical readings

- A Wedding Celebration Package contract whose linked group room block carries 25 contracted room nights sits exactly on that package's threshold of 25; one with 24 sits below it.
- A Half-Day Meeting Package contract whose food and beverage revenue comes to 1,500.00 has reached its 1,500.00 minimum; one at 1,499.99 has not.
